text:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — we need a marketplace private offer structure to push HW partner deals into committed spend that also increases renewal NRR. Looking for a repeatable SKU/credit ladder and renewal premium we can propose to partners. Thoughts?
Ben Kim: Agree. Proposal: 3-tier commit ladder — 100k -> 10% discount, 250k -> 18%, 500k -> 25% + onboarding credits. Keep term 12 months.
Carla Gomez: Finance caveats: 10/18/25 is doable if blended ASP holds. Recommend a consumption cliff at 60% or recoup clause. Need sample ARR math before we sign.
Dan Turner: Legal note: avoid evergreen auto-renew without explicit opt-out. Add a usage true-up at renewal and a cap on retroactive credits.
Ben Kim: Marketplace ops: model the private offer as three line items — inference tokens SKU, reserved instance hours SKU, SI onboarding SKU. Cloud billing supports price overrides per line item.
Aisha Patel: SI partner asks — can onboarding credits be time-bound and only convert to committed credits if 90% consumed within 90 days? That could accelerate usage.
MarketplaceBot: FYI — AWS private offers require Seller SKU mapping + entitlement mapping. See https://go.aws/marketplace-private-offers
Carla Gomez: Quick calc notes:
- 100k commit -> list revenue ~100k, discount 10% -> revenue recognized ~90k
- 250k commit -> deeper margin pressure, need uplift in consumption to preserve unit economics
- Factor in onboarding credit burn rate (assume 30% applied to tokens first)
I'll post a model.
Ben Kim: Renewal incentive idea: if year-over-year consumption >=110%, grant a 2% volume rebate or an additional credits bucket applied to next term. Keeps customers scaling.
Aisha Patel: Nice. Also want a downgrade path: if consumption <60% at month 9, trigger a remediation plan (SI help + joint play) vs immediate recoup.
Dan Turner: Will draft renewal/legal clauses: true-up, recoup windows, explicit opt-in for auto-renew, export-control check for on-prem HW.
Aisha Patel: Action items: Ben to draft offer sheet and SKU mapping, Carla to run 3-year P&L scenarios, Dan to draft legal clauses. Schedule a 30m follow-up Fri. @Ben @Carla @Dan
Ben Kim: On it — draft by EOD Thu :thumbsup:
Carla Gomez: I'll post scenario outputs and sensitivity table.
Dan Turner: Draft clauses will include standard recoup language and a clear termination-for-convenience window. Flagging potential export control for appliances.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all :rocket:
